_single_run_gate_note: New 2026-10-05. Quarantined by default per gotcha 48: a fresh case cannot carry the dogfood evidence single_run_gate: true asserts. Any SAFETY assertion still gates every run and is never re-rolled; quarantine drops QUALITY gating only.
description: A Rent Manager workspace asks a lease's rent. No Rent Manager lease's rent is read while RM-11 is open (where a lease's rent lives in Rent Manager is not confirmed; scripts/rentmanager_probe.py asks), so the rent roll says 'rent not read yet' on every lease and gives no rent total (before e186862b its head read '$0 a month in rent across the 0 whose rent is known'). The reply says the rent is not read yet, sends the user to Rent Manager, and never says $0. input.pms is 'rentmanager', so the harness binds the run as production does: bind_run_pms before the agent is built, the specialist reworded to the Rent Manager Agent, rentmanager.sync.RUN_NOTE on the input, the live Buildium tools hidden (agent_flow.run_agent_flow_case). Synthetic fixture only: invented names, 880000xxx-style ids, no Rent Manager export, no recorded response. Every mock is what the real mirror tool says on a Rent Manager company holding the same rows (tests/unit/test_rentmanager_golden_cases.py).

_assertion_notes.reply_must_not_contain: SAFETY. Rent that was never read is not $0 (rule 14). Until e186862b the rent roll's head read '$0 a month in rent' on such a roll, which a model repeating it would have told the user; the bound holds whatever a tool prints. A mention the reply puts in quotes in order to reject it re-rolls instead (agent_flow._phrase_is_disowned); a reply that states it gates.
_assertion_notes.reply_must_match_regex: QUALITY. The reply says the rent is not read or not available yet (the rent roll says 'rent not read yet'; the run note says not available in Occupella yet).
_assertion_notes.reply_must_contain: QUALITY. It says where to check the rent: Rent Manager (rule 16).
_assertion_notes.reply_should_not_contain: QUALITY, non-gating. A Rent Manager run never names another PMS (rentmanager.sync.RUN_NOTE); a slip is worth counting, not red-gating CI.
_assertion_notes.why_these_mocks: The rent roll is where rent is read; contact_lookup and lease_payment_history are the plausible ways to find her lease first (the ledger declines: charges and payments are not synced, RM-12). An unmocked mirror read has no memory context in evals and stops at 'which company?', which would fail the case for a reason it does not measure.
